meta.name: refactor
meta.description: Guides a refactor, cleanup, or restructure with the right decomposition. Use when the user asks to refactor, simplify, extract, or modernize code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把又长又乱的代码拆解整理成清晰好改的模块
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手上有一堆难维护的老代码,想先理清结构再继续开发
copy.tagline_en: Break tangled code into clean, well-organized modules
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you inherited messy code and want it structured before building further.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 处理重构会走固定流程:先确认目标和范围,再探索代码库、评估测试覆盖,生成分步计划后逐步改动,每步跑测试和类型检查,不过就停下回滚。
howto.when: 当你要求重构、简化、抽取代码等改动时触发,通常以 /refactor <目标> 调用,可用 --scope、--strategy 等参数指定范围和风险偏好。

say.note: 进入意图确认与代码库分析

say.text: 把 AuthService 的校验逻辑抽成独立模块
say.note: 先确认范围与测试覆盖再动手
测试覆盖不足时会先建议补测试

howto.what_en: Claude follows a fixed refactor flow: confirm goal and scope, explore the codebase, assess test coverage, plan steps, then change code and verify each step with tests and type checks—stopping and reverting on failure.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to refactor, simplify, extract or modernize code, usually via /refactor <target> with --scope and --strategy for range and risk.

say_en.note: Starts intent check and codebase analysis

say_en.text: Extract the validation logic in AuthService into its own module

say_en.note: Suggests adding tests if coverage is low
